description: The Encore Burst 200 is an IPX4 rated, high intensity dual lens audience blinder/strobe. It’s powered by two 110W warm white (2700K) CREE COB LEDs. The fixture is constructed with a rugged metal housing and an aluminum extrusion rails system to connect multiple fixtures to create a larger cluster of fixtures in a vertical or horizontal array. The fixture features a Tungsten Mode effect that replicates a halogen-like dimming profile.

creator: ADJ Products
description:
The ADJ Lighting Focus Spot 4Z is a compact moving head that brings exceptional versatility to any lighting setup. Powered by a brilliant 200W cool white LED engine, this fixture is designed to deliver stunning visuals in temporary live events and fixed installations, such as nightclubs, stages, and churches. With motorized focus and zoom capabilities ranging from 11 to 22 degrees, the Focus Spot 4Z allows you to offer creative lighting effects for a wide variety of applications.

Equipped with an array of impressive features, the Focus Spot 4Z is a professional-grade lighting solution. It boasts a GOBO wheel with 6 rotating and replaceable patterns, 8 vibrant colors plus white, and two prism wheels – a 5-facet linear prism and a 6-facet circular prism – for dazzling projections. The fixture also offers advanced control options, including 16-bit fine pan and tilt, multiple DMX control modes, and six different dimming options.

creator: ADJ Products
description:

63 built-in color macros utilizing red, green, blue, amber, white and UV LEDs. Not only is
this LED Par great for lighting stages, but with its patent pending, intelligently designed,
power and DMX connectors, it’s great for uplighting a venue.

description: Combining an immense 660-Watt LED engine, an impressive 25,000+ Lumens, and expansive feature set, ADJ’s IP65-rated Hydro Profile is a professional lighting powerhouse. A 4-blade rotatable framing system, alongside motorized zoom (6 ~ 45 degrees), motorized focus and iris, together with 2 frost filters, facilitate precise manipulation of the output. A CMY color mixing system, combined with a CTO flag and 7 slot replaceable color wheel, allow for exceptional versatility and creative freedom. Meanwhile, 2 GOBO wheels, 2 rotating prisms, and an animation wheel allow for the creation of an almost unlimited variety of aerial effects and surface pattern projections.

description: The brightest and most feature-rich Focus Series fixture to date, the Focus Profile is a professional caliber automated profile luminaire designed for theatrical, concert touring and event production applications. It features a potent 400W LED engine, with a native color temperature of 6,700K and a CRI in excess of 70, coupled with an exhaustive collection of beam-shaping tools. These include four, independently controllable, rotating framing shutter blades, which can be used to precisely shape the light output. The unit offers full CMY color mixing together with variable CTO color temperature control (2700K to 6700K) and an additional color wheel loaded with 6 dichroic filters comprised of four primaries together with CTB and CRI filters. Two separate GOBO wheels feature 7 replaceable, indexed-rotating GOBOs, and 8 static GOBOs, respectively, while two bi-directional rotating prisms (3-facet and 4-facet) allow for the creation of a wide variety of aerial effects.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The Jolt Panel FX is an extremely versatile fixture ideal for concert tours, one-off event production and permanent nightclub installations. It features a central strip of 48 x 5-Watt cool white SMD LEDs, surrounded on both sides by a total of 800 x 0.3W RGB SMD LEDs. This provides lighting designers with the creative potential of generating both strikingly bright white strobe effects and vibrant color washes from the same compact fixture.

creator: ADJ Products
description: Offering an efficient 200W LED light source combined with an extensive feature set, the ADJ Focus Hybrid is a versatile moving head luminaire. It can function interchangeably as a spot, wash or beam fixture, making it ideal for rental and event production applications as well as for installation in venues that require a moving light which can deliver a high degree of flexibility. It features motorized zoom and focus, two GOBO wheels, an independent color wheel, two rotating prisms and a replaceable frost filter.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The Focus Flex offers lighting designers the creative flexibility of generating vibrant washes, punchy beams, and eye-catching pixel effects from one compact and quick automated luminaire. Powered by an array of seven potent 40-Watt 4-in-1 RGBW color mixing LEDs, each of which can be controlled independently, it offers a motorized zoom function providing the versatility of a variable field angle of between 6 and 57-degrees. With a variety of DMX mode options appropriate to different applications, it offers virtual CMY color mixing and virtual foreground and background color wheel control as well as a choice of seven different DMX modes.

creator: ADJ Products
description:
The ADJ Lighting Mirage Q6 PAK is an all-in-one event up lighting system with six (6) IP65 rated, for outdoor or indoor use, battery powered fixtures and a durable flight case with an on-board battery charging solution.

Each Mirage Q6 IP fixture is powered by four (4) 10W RGBA LEDs that produce a 11-degree beam angle. The fixture is IP65 rated and is waterproof; suitable for temporary use outdoors with protection against the elements (rain, snow, dust and sand). Built-in WiFLY EXR wireless DMX allows for the fixtures to communicate with a lighting controller, also with WiFLY EXR wireless DMX, up to 2,500 feet (700M) away.

Ideal for wall washing, Mirage Q6 IP fixtures are all fitted with an integral carry handle and built-in feet which mean they can simply be dropped in place and are ready to go. They also feature a built-in kickstand which allows the beam to be easily angled inwards towards a wall if required.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The Ultra LB18 from ADJ is a powerful and versatile linear LED wash lighting fixture, designed for permanent installation or temporary event use at indoor locations. It features 18 x 10-Watt 5-in-1 color mixing LEDs (red, green, blue, amber & lime) and a beam angle of 17 x 40-degrees. The inclusion of a lime LED chip not only increases the palette of colors available from the fixture, but also boosts the CRI of its white light output. It is supplied with brackets that can be used to set the fixture directly on the ground or to attach a clamp for truss mounting and the ends are also magnetic to allow adjacent fixtures to be quickly and easily aligned.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The ADJ 7P HEX IP is a versatile, heavy duty Par with HEX LEDs, a 25-degree beam angle, and all metal construction. It is IP65 outdoor rated to protect against, rain, snow and dust for temporary outdoor events.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The ADJ Jolt Bar FX is a professional linear LED fixture that delivers lighting designers huge output as well as the creative potential of brilliant bright white strobe/blinder LEDs combined with multi-colored chase effects in one versatile unit. Ideal for concert productions, festival stages and rental houses, as well as for permanent installation in large nightclubs, the Jolt Bar FX is a flexible fixture that can be used to create a wide variety of effects.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The ADJ Pinspot LED Quad DMX is a 8-Watt Quad Color (4-IN-1) Pinspot with red, green, blue and white diodes on one LED. It produces sharp 15-degree beams on light, and is designed to spot tables, decor, architecture or used for special effects.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The ADJ Encore LP12IP is a versatile, heavy duty Par with twelve (12) 20W Quad LEDs (4-IN-1: Red, Green, Blue & Lime), a 10° beam angle, and all metal construction. It is IP65 outdoor rated to protect against, rain, snow and dust for temporary outdoor events. It offers flicker free operation for TV and film and linear white color temperature control from 2700K - 7000K. A removable 25-degree frost filter is included.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The new Pocket Pro is truly a transformed fixture from the base up. We listened to what customers wanted in a compact and affordable Spot moving head. On the top of the head is a manual focusing wheel that allows users easy and precise focusing of the GOBOs so they look crisp in a variety of applications.

creator: ADJ Products
description: Offering an impressive output of 20,000 Lumens, the ADJ Focus Spot 7Z is a powerful and feature-packed moving head spot luminaire capable of producing spot and wash effects. Its efficient 420W LED light engine and superior optics allow the fixture to deliver crisp and even projections, while its extensive collection of integrated beam-shaping tools provide lighting designers with immense creative potential. These include full CMY + CTO color mixing; an animation wheel; motorized zoom (6° ~ 48°), focus and iris; as well as twin GOBO wheels, rotating prisms and frost filters.

creator: ADJ Products
description: Part of the expanding ADJ Entour Series of atmospheric machines, the Entour Haze Pro is a touring-grade haze machine built into a durable flight case. It requires no warm-up time and, with an air pressure of 101psi, is able to generate an impressive output of 3,000 cubic ft. per minute. This allows large stages and venues to be easily and quickly filled with lightshow-enhancing haze whenever it is required. The machine uses Haze/G™ oil-based liquid and has an external fluid tank capacity of 2.5 Liters. It has an extremely efficient fluid consumption rate of 15 hours continuous output per Liter, which means that 37.5 hours of haze can be generated from a single tank of fluid.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The ADJ Lighting Encore LP12Z IP is a an IP65-Rated wash fixture with motorized zoom, wireless DMX and a variety of useful professional control tools for staging and event application. Its twelve 20W Quad RGBL (Red, Green, Blue and Lime) LEDs allow for a wide array of colors to be produced, tunable white color control from 2700K to 6500K and an attractive CRI output.

creator: ADJ Products
description: 300W LED CMY Hybrid Moving Head with CMY color mixing, Onboard WiFLY EXR wireless DMX, 2 GOBO wheels, 9 color + open (including CTO 3200K & UV), 2 Prism wheels, motorized focus, zoom and iris; 3-pin & 5-pin DMX and locking power In/Out connections.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The Focus Flex L19 by ADJ Lighting is a powerful moving head luminaire that offers versatility and creativity to lighting designers. It features 19 40-Watt RGBL color mixing LEDs that can be controlled independently, allowing for a broad range of output colors. The fixture also offers Virtual CMY mode, Virtual Foreground and Background Color Wheel control, and variable color temperature. With motorized zoom and fine pan & tilt motor control, the Focus Flex L19 can create broad washes, concise beams, and impressive aerial effects.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The ADJ Encore Z7LP is a versatile LED par fixture that offers a motorized zoom function with a variable beam angle of 5 – 50-degrees. It features an arrangement of 7 x 20-Watt 4-in-1 (red, green, blue, lime) color mixing LEDs which combine to deliver a punchy wash output across a huge gamut of colors. In addition, the fixture creates variable white color temperatures from 2700K to 7000K.

creator: ADJ Products
description: ADJ’s Hydro Spot 2 is an IP65-rated professional moving head luminaire powered by a potent 320-Watt cool white LED engine. It offers an impressive 15,000 lumen output while featuring a wide variety of beam shaping tools to provide lighting designers with almost limitless creative potential. Its features include motorized zoom (8 to 41-degrees) and focus; two frost filters; CMY color mixing, variable CTO flag and independent color wheel; two GOBO wheels (one fixed, one rotating and replaceable); two rotating prisms (6-facet circular and 5-facet linear); and an animation wheel.

creator: ADJ Products
description:
The VF Flurry is a highly efficient, 1250W Snow Machine. It has a spray distance of 2-5 meters. Features include: Low/High volume selection switch, low snow fluid shut off to protect the pump, snow fluid level indicator, 2.3 Liter internal snow fluid tank, and an On/Off switch on the rear panel. The VF Flurry uses water based snow fluid.
ADJ recommends SNOW GAL, snow juice that been specially formulated for ADJ snow machines.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The Focus Flex L7 offers lighting designers the creative flexibility of generating vibrant washes, punchy beams, and eye-catching pixel effects from one compact and quick automated luminaire. Powered by an array of seven potent 40-Watt 4-in-1 RGBL color mixing LEDs, each of which can be controlled independently, it offers a motorized zoom function providing the versatility of a variable beam angle of between 6 and 55-degrees. With a variety of DMX mode options appropriate to different applications, it offers virtual CMY color mixing and virtual foreground and background color wheel control as well as a choice of seven different DMX modes ranging from 16 to 50 channels.

creator: ADJ Products
description:
The Eliminator Lighting Stryker Wash is a 228W professional moving head wash featuring nineteen 12W 4-IN-1 (RGBW) LEDs, and motorized zoom (6 ~ 50-degrees) that allows the versatility to use this fixture as a wide wash or tight beam. Along with a massive palette of colors to choose from, the Stryker Wash also has an independent linear white color temperature control channel that can change from 3200K to 10,000K. This allows users to color correct the illumination of different skin tones of people on stage.

The Stryker Wash has variable strobe speeds, a 3-zone control mode with macros, and a large color display that makes navigation of the fixture’s menu system for setup and DMX addressing very easy. The fixture has fast, precise pan and tilt movements, along with fine pan/tilt, allowing for precision performance.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The ADJ Lighting Hydro Spot 1 is a feature-packed, LED-powered moving head spot luminaire housed within a robust IP65-rated housing. Featuring a potent 200-Watt cool white LED engine, it delivers punchy output which can be manipulated using an extensive collection of beam-shaping tools. These include motorized zoom (for a beam angle of 12° ~ 23°), motorized focus, two frost filters (light and heavy), two rotating prisms (5-facet linear & 6-facet circular), 6 rotating and replaceable GOBOs, and two color wheels (each with 8 options).

description: Drawing on the popularity of Chip On Board (C.O.B.) LED from the Dotz Par fixture, the ADJ Lighting Dotz Par RGBL uses the latest advancements in lighting technology with a RGBL (red, green, blue, lime) C.O.B. LED for a smooth, even field, high CRI output, advanced color mixing and tunable white color temperature control from 2700K to 6500K.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The MBDMX-PLUS motor will allow you to control up to 4 units simultaneously via 3-pin DMX In/Out and allow for a synchronized motor rotation and universal speed. This will results in many dramatic visual effects. Circuit Breaker protection is included so you don't need to worry about changing fuses. The MBDMX-PLUS motor is meant for indoor use only but is great for night clubs, mobile entertainers, bands, and permanent installations. Plus, there are two 3-prong Edison plus on the motor for powering pinspots or other lighting fixtures to light up the mirror ball.

creator: ADJ Products
description: Vintage X combines retro amber blinder effects (2000K) with vibrant background RGB LEDs, offering rich multi-color eye candy effects and smooth dimming. With advanced controllability, built-in lightshows, and versatile connectivity, it’s perfect for creative stage and event lighting setups.

creator: ADJ Products
description: Hydro Flex L7 is an IP65-rated 420W professional moving head wash fixture with seven 60W RGBL LEDs with individual pixel control, tunable white color temperature control (2,700K – 10,000K), motorized zoom and includes Aria X2 wireless management system built-in. With a rugged IP65-rated compact case design, a potent LED engine, and a wealth of professional-grade features, the Hydro Flex L7 is a great solution for outdoor or indoor stage environments.

creator: ADJ Products
description: Hydro Flex L19 is an IP65-rated 1,140W professional moving head wash fixture with nineteen 60W RGBL LEDs with individual pixel control, tunable white color temperature control (2,700K – 10,000K), motorized zoom and includes Aria X2 wireless management system built-in. With a rugged IP65-rated case design, a potent LED engine, and a wealth of professional-grade features, the Hydro Flex L19 is a great solution for outdoor or indoor stage environments.

creator: ADJ Products
description:
The UV PAR 100IP is a robust and adaptable ultraviolet LED fixture, perfect for professional lighting setups that require
a strong black light effect. Its IP65 rating ensures dependable protection from dust, sand, and moisture, making it
suitable for both indoor and outdoor environments. Featuring a 100-Watt C.O.B. (Chip On Board) UV LED, it provides a
massive 120-degree beam angle and operates in the 390-399nm wavelength range, delivering vibrant and consistent
UV lighting.

creator: ADJ Products
description:
The ADJ Hydro Wash X7 is an IP65 rated 280W professional moving head wash fixture with seven 40W RGBW (4-IN-1) LEDs.
With robust construction and IP65-ratings, the Hydro Wash X7 is designed for both indoor or outdoor use. Its durable metal casing protects it from dust, sand, moisture and liquids, making it ideal for use in all situations from dusty deserts in California to rainy fields in England. Perfect for festivals and outdoor events, as well as installation in open-air clubs and other outside entertainment spaces where wash lighting is a must. This groundbreaking fixture offer an extended operational life and reduced maintenance requirement due to its long-life LED and sealed casing design.

creator: ADJ Products
description:
The ADJ Lighting Encore FR Pro WW is a professional grade Fresnel fixture with a 7-inch lens designed for key light, as a fill light and as a back light. It offers a potent 200W warm white LED 
 
The Encore FR Pro Color has a motorized zoom (beam angle of 10~46°), a CRI rating of 97.2 with an output of more than 12,000 Lumens. There are an abundant of on-board features such as 4 DMX control modes, 4 Dim Curves, 6 Dim Modes and adjustable refresh rates.
 
The fixture has DMX-512 and RDM protocols, a USB service port, a 4-Button control panel LCD menu display, 2 rotary controls for Zoom en Dimmer 3 & 5-pin DMX In/Out sockets and locking power In/Out to daisy chain power from one fixture to another. 
 
A rotating 8-leaf barn door, gel frame and power cord are included with the fixture.

creator: ADJ Products
description: Expanding on the success of the UBL12H, the innovative UBL12HB is a battery-operated, 1-meter linear LED wash luminaire. It features a lime-enhanced HEX LED with twelve (12) 20-Watt LEDs in Red, Green, Blue, Amber, Lime, and UV. The addition of the lime chip delivers superior color rendering with a CRI exceeding 90 and offers adjustable white light ranging from 2,300K to 9,900K.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The Jolt Bar FXIP is an IP65-rated professional linear LED fixture that delivers Lighting Designers huge output as well as the creative potential of brilliant bright white strobe/blinder LEDs combined with multi-colored chase effects in one versatile unit. It is a highly flexible fixture that can be used to create a wide variety of effects ideal for concert productions, festival stages and other largescale events.

creator: sam.chandler@conductr.com
description: The Jolt Bar FXIP is an IP65-rated professional linear LED fixture that delivers Lighting Designers huge output as well as the creative potential of brilliant bright white strobe/blinder LEDs combined with multi-colored chase effects in one versatile unit. It is a highly flexible fixture that can be used to create a wide variety of effects ideal for concert productions, festival stages and other largescale events.

creator: ADJ Products
description: With added features over its predecessor, the Jolt Bar FX2 is a highly flexible fixture that can be used to create a wide variety of effects ideal for concert productions, festival stages and rental houses, as well as for permanent installation in large nightclubs.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The Jolt Panel FX2 provides lighting designers with the creative potential of generating strikingly bright white strobe flashes, vibrant color washes, and animated ‘eye candy’ chase effects ideal for concert productions, festival stages and rental houses, as well as for permanent installation in large nightclubs.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The IP65-Rated Jolt Panel FXIP is an extremely bright and versatile fixture ideal for concert tours, one-off event production and permanent nightclub installations. It features a central strip of 48 x 5-Watt cool white SMD LEDs, surrounded on both sides by a total of 800 x 0.5-Watt RGB SMD LEDs. The Jolt Panel FXIP provides lighting designers with the creative potential of generating strikingly bright white strobe flashes, vibrant color washes, and animated ‘eye candy’ chase effects from the same compact fixture which can be used inside or outdoors in any weather.

description: Get smooth, strong lighting effects with the ADJ Inno Color Beam Z7. Featuring 7x 10W RGBW Quad Color Osram LEDS, fast pan tilt movement, plus motorized zoom with variable beam angle from 10-60 degrees. Three operational modes and 5 dimmer curve modes make it the ultimate in versatility.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The perfect addition to any small venues such as nightclubs, bars, stages, churches or mobile performers, the Inno Pocket Spot give a professional Moving Head light show. This compact mover is powered by a bright 12W LED engine. A "you have to see it to believe it" brightness! Compatible with the ADJ Airstream IR App.

creator: ADJ Products
description: Vizi Pix Z19 is a cutting-edge tool for modern lighting designers, delivering a stunning array of dynamic effects and advanced virtual CMY color mixing for an unforgettable live experience. Featuring 19x 30-Watt RGBL LEDs, vibrant RGB background LEDs, and an innovative LED ring, it creates immersive beams, washes, and vibrant color effects that captivate audiences.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The Vizi Wash Z37 is a 740W professional moving head wash fixture with variable motorized zoom (10 ~ 60-degrees) and thirty-seven 20W Quad (RGBW / 4-IN-1) LEDs.

creator: ADJ Products
description: Featuring a high output 200-Watt COB (Chip On Board) LED engine, the ADJ COB Cannon LP200X is a potent color mixing wash lighting fixture. Its 5-in-1 light source combines red, green, blue, amber and lime LED chips to allow the creation of a huge gamut of colors with a high CRI, plus a tunable white color temperature between 2300K and 9900K. A compact and versatile fixture, it offers a wide 80-degree native beam angle but is also supplied with both 40-degree and 50-degree lens options. This fixture includes the Aria X2 wireless management system.

creator: ajgilson77
description: Featuring a high output 200-Watt COB (Chip On Board) LED engine, the ADJ COB Cannon LP200X is a potent color mixing wash lighting fixture. Its 5-in-1 light source combines red, green, blue, amber and lime LED chips to allow the creation of a huge gamut of colors with a high CRI, plus a tunable white color temperature between 2300K and 9900K. A compact and versatile fixture, it offers a wide 80-degree native beam angle but is also supplied with both 40-degree and 50-degree lens options. This fixture includes the Aria X2 wireless management system.

creator: ADJ Products
description: The ADJ Focus Spot 6Z is a feature-packed, compact moving head spot fixture powered by a 300W cool white LED engine. It is equipped with motorized focus, motorized zoom, motorized Iris, two prisms and two frost filters. It has two GOBO wheels and two color wheels. The rear panel has PowerLock In/Out to daisy chain power, 3-pin and 5-pin DMX In/Out and RJ45 connections.

creator: RedBeardKelley
description: The ADJ Focus Spot 6Z is a feature-packed, compact moving head spot fixture powered by a 300W cool white LED engine. It is equipped with motorized focus, motorized zoom, motorized Iris, two prisms and two frost filters. It has two GOBO wheels and two color wheels. The rear panel has PowerLock In/Out to daisy chain power, 3-pin and 5-pin DMX In/Out and RJ45 connections.

creator: ADJ Products
description: Delivering output of up to 16,000 lumens and an extensive feature set, the Protégé XM is a versatile LED-powered moving head spot luminaire. Its 350W LED engine has a native color temperature of 8000K and its precision-engineered optics deliver crisp GOBO projections and striking aerial effects with a beam angle variable between 3.8° and 44°. The fixture is packed with useful features, including CMY color mixing alongside two color wheels, two rotating GOBO wheels, two prisms, two frost filters, and an animation wheel. It offers extensive control options for integration into any professional lighting system, including support for sACN and Art-Net as well as onboard Aria X2 wireless DMX and remote fixture management.

description: Shocker 2 is a punchy dual zone blinder with warm white 85-watt COB LEDs. Perfect for theatrical productions, concerts, dance floors and more, Shocker 2 has an included expansion bracket that allows quick attachment of a second unit to create a 4-head blinder. Adjustable pulse width modulation (PWM) control is on board to eliminate flicker on camera. Shocker 2 has PowerCON®-compatible power input/output connections for power linking and flexible control options with onboard 3- and 5-pin DMX connectors.

creator: LTT
description: Intimidator Spot 375ZX is a feature-packed compact moving head designed for large events. 200 watts of lighting power are just the start of the robust and convenient options on board. Along with a color wheel updated with CTO technology, Intimidator Spot 375Z X has a built-in RF receiver for wireless control allows use of the RFC or RFC-XL optional remotes putting unprecedented moving head control options in the palm of your hand without having to aim the remotes at the unit. And Intimidator Spot 375Z X is not only energized, it’s motorized! Motorized zoom is on board and is perfect for short or long throw applications and project crisp gobos from nearly any distance with the motorized focus too! A brand new home position allows for smoother programming, eliminating the need for full head rotation to start lighting looks. Dual rotating prisms split the beam for great effects and cover a larger area. Set, save, and recall 1 scene manually, directly from the full color LCD display.

description: Meet Xcellence with Intimidator Spot 360X, a compact moving head packed with features to make any mobile event Xhilarating! description: Lighting Xcellence is at hand! Unlock it with Intimidator Beam 360X a dynamic, 110-watt compact moving head designed for a variety of mobile events. creator: LTT
description: Maverick Force S Profile is ideal for small to medium multi-faceted projects in need of seamless color-mixing, advanced optics, framing shutters, and control options in a lightweight frame. Just over 50 lbs, this compact unit features a smart optical system that maximizes the output of 14,000 lumens and provides high-quality color mixing with a CTB filter. A 7-slot color wheel is also added with split-color combinations in mind. Maverick Force S Profile includes a custom framing system equipped with dual axis movement and a 120° complete module rotation for fast beam shaping. A speedy effects artillery includes motorized iris, frost, focus, a 5-facet prism and wide zoom ranging from 4.5° to 41.6°. Additionally, custom gobos created in collaboration with leading designers can be stacked on top of one another for dynamic effects. That is a lot packed in a small frame standing just over 2 ft tall. Control as you see fit with DMX, sACN, Art-Net or W-DMX.

creator: CHAUVET Professional
description: Rogue R3 Beam is the light cannon of the Rogue series, outputting over 208,000 lux at 15 meters from its 300 W Ushio NSL lamp. This fully-featured beam can be focused down to 0.8° degrees for extremely focused aerial effects alongside motorized frost and focus options. A color wheel equipped with 14 colors complimented by a gobo wheel with 17 gobos give you a wealth of dynamic effects, and both wheels are fully scrollable at variable speeds. Additionally, the unit features individually overlapping 8 and 24-facet prisms for an endless supply of creative beam looks. The unit is equipped with RDM and DMX protocols and features multiple control personalities.

creator: LTT
description: Color STRIKE M is an IP65 rated motorized strobe/wash with two ultra-bright, white light tube elements surrounded by an electrifying, color-mixing, and pixel-mappable face. This versatile strobe light can double as a wash fixture with 180° tilt range to throw bright saturated color wherever you need. The IP65 casing protects the fixture from any environmental factors or weather and has two omega-bracket attachments so you can mount the fixture horizontally or vertically without any hassle. Multiple programming personalities give you a varying amount of control from simple set ups with a multitude of built-in effects, or wider control options to take advantage of the pixel-mappable zones: 14 in the RGB face and 28 in the two tube elements. Built-in alignment pins insure perfectly straight linear arrays to create massive arrangements. DMX, Art-net, and sACN control. All LEDs feature 16-bit dimming for smooth fades and Pulse Width Modulation for on-camera use.

description: The PROTRON ECLYPSE™ is a versatile high powered 1000W air cooled IPX4 outdoor rated color blinder, strobe, wash luminaire. description: The FUZE WASH Z350™ is a single source par moving head luminaire featuring a 350W Quad Color RGBW COB LED, 6° to 46° motorized zoom, pan and tilt, RGBW color mixing, variable dimming curve and strobe effects, DMX and RDM (remote device management) protocol support, DMX and Locking Power Cable in/out connections, LCD menu display with 7 button control panel, multiple unit power linking, flicker free operation for TV and FILM, and a multi-voltage universal auto switching power supply (110-240v).

description:

Rugged and portable, the fixture can be mounted on a stand or suspended using any standard clamp or the included Junior pin adapter.

SMARTY MAX is the Extreme Output Hybrid featuring the new Philips MSD Platinum FLEX 400 lamp and Elation's 2 year / 4,000 hours Ultimate Warranty.** Rated at 480W and up to 4,000 hours smart lamp life the SMARTY MAX includes CMY and variable CTO and is the world’s first Hybrid incorporating a full Iris for dynamic beam effects. Four prisms on two planes, dual frosts plus dual gobo wheel and the unique dual track animation round out the comprehensive FX package in a compact and lightweight housing. Delivering 21,000 lumens from its large 160mm front aperture, the SMARTY MAX has a crisp output for extremely powerful beams, sharp gobos and bright washes, making it a flexible fixture for almost any application, while providing an excellent return on investment.

The PROTEUS EXCALIBUR is the newest member in the industry leading Proteus range of IP65 automated fixtures from Elation Professional. Excalibur is the brightest IP65 fully featured beam fixture ever created with incredible light output from a surprisingly compact fixture body. Rivaling existing Xenon searchlights or skytrackers, the extremely narrow 0.8° Beam ensures the fixture cuts effortlessly through the sky and is visible at great distances. The intense beam of the PROTEUS EXCALIBUR projects from the ultra-wide 260mm front Lens as a massive column of light that stuns the audience. 

 A wide array of gobos and prism overlays allow animating the sky, and with its incredible light intensity all CMY colors remain strong and vibrant even when fully saturated. Beam control is provided through a precise internal focus lens, providing crisp projection without optical errors. Dual variable frosts allow to soften the beam when required.

The KL PROFILE FC™ is a manual LED framing fixture designed for a wide array of precision lighting applications. With an integrated manual zoom range of 7 to 50 degrees the fixture requires no additional lens tubes, reducing cost, complexity and providing excellent flexibility for any theater, performance venue or show. The integrated manual Iris allows further beam control.

The 92 CRI engine utilizes a 5-color homogenized LED array consisting of Red, Green, Blue, Mint, and Amber sources with a power of 305W. The carefully tuned LEDs ensure accurate color reproduction while delivering a powerful output of over 10,000 lumens. Virtual color temperature, Magenta / Green adjustment provide the designer with immediate access to the impressive LED color array. Exceptionally quiet, the fixture offers enhanced fan controls down to Elation’s Mute Mode which disables the internal cooling fan.

description:
The Artiste Mondrian™ is an extremely bright, full-featured LED profile FX fixture offering high center intensity, narrow-beam angles and a wide color-mixing gamut through its variable SpectraColor engine.

Providing up to 51,000 lumens from its efficient 950W 6,500K LED engine, the Mondrian is the ideal fixture for any application requiring superior output, bright and powerful narrow beams, and quiet operation, as well as stunning effects and colors. Mondrian integrates Elation's new SpectraColor system, which offers traditional CMY mixing but adds a variable RGB color mix for rich, saturated primaries. In combination with the variable CTO, the Mondrian allows for colors that were previously impossible to achieve, from theatrical pastels to the most vibrant red or blues ever produced by a color mixing system. The Artiste Mondrian’s wide color gamut is achieved by seven color-mixing flags with 16-bit precision for artistic possibilities that are truly inspiring.

description: The Exo Wash 30 from FUSION by GLP is an IP65 rated Moving Head wash fixture with a full feature set in a compact housing. Featuring a durable and robust die cast housing, the Exo Wash 30 is ready for the toughest of outdoor weather conditions. With 7 powerful 32 W RGBW Osram LEDs, the FUSION Exo Wash 30 delivers a solid, bright beam in a full color range from the deepest saturates to the lightest pastel shades, and offers color control over each individual pixel. Supporting the stunning output is a zooming optical system that can vary the beam continuously from 4° to 54°. The Exo Wash 30 incorporates True1 In/Out connectors, variable PWM control and also features easy to use magnetic head mounts, for filter holders and any other future attachments.

description: The new GLP impression FR1 is the latest compact LED moving head which offers a soft pencil beam and super fast movement and continuous pan rotation for amazing 3D multi beam designs. But that's not all – the optical system can move from a 4°soft narrow beam to a 35°soft wide wash light. Optionally it is possible to remove the soft front diffusor to get a more hard edge beam in 3,7°. The high quality OsramRGBW Quad LED emits saturated colors and white light of all relevant color temperatures – selectable via RGBW-or CTO-Control. The new micro Fresnel front lens has a homogeny round image and visibility at plan view – which is needed for TV applications. The GLP impression FR1 has been designed with the famous baseless design and an extremely and compact body easily fitting into the tightest spaces of set designs from concert and touring stages, television and film, corporate events, set lighting to special events.

creator: German Light Products
description: The impression X4 features 19 high power RGBW LEDs, each rated at 15W with a 7° – 50° zoom range. The housing design is based on the legendary, and award winning, impression 90 and 120RZ fixtures including their baseless design and small footprint. The brand new optical system gives a well defined beam, complete with hard edge in the lower zoom range whilst remaining absolutely homogenous and soft edged at wider angles. RGBW color mixing, variable CTO and a finely tuned dimming curve are standard in the impression X4. The impression X4 features individually controllable LEDs allowing a range of different patterns to be created and displayed on the front lenses, including arrows, numbers, letters and much more, either from stock patterns or through user created patterns.

description: Moving Head wash light with illuminated surface diameter 260 mm consisting of 19 circularly arranged RGBL LEDs each 40W. Adjustable default white points of 6500K, 8000K, 5600K, 4200K and 3200K as well as continuous temporary CCT adjustment from 10000K to 2500K. Color rendering of CRI 86 and TLCI 85 at 6500K and CRI 85 and TLCI 74 at 3200K. Color mixing via 16 bit resolved RGB, RGBL or xy channels with total luminous flux up to 12500 lm at RGBL at maximum luminous intensity up to 1.97 Mcd. Fast motorized zoom from 3.5° beam angle up to 63° Cutt off angel. Virtual color wheel with 64 LEE referenced color presets, Magenta Green correction, Color Quality channel, Tungsten effect channel, extended RGBL color spaces, second effect layer with static and dynamic pattern macros, Mix Priority channel, The motorized head can be moved in 16 bit resolution by 540/650° pan and 240° tilt. The total weight is 13.3 kg (29.3 lbs.).

description: With a new optical system, the impression FR10 Bar uses a larger size output aperture, as used in the impression FR1 giving a new look from a familiar style. The impression FR10 Bar contains 10 sources, each containing a high output 60 Watt RGBW LED that color matches with the entire GLP X4 and FR series of fixtures. Each individual source features smooth, full range color mixing with strong, punchy output from a homogenized Fresnel lens. Along with individual color control, the impression FR10 Bar contains a series of built in color macros and a large reference of industry standard color filters.

creator: German Light Products
description:
With the ArenaLED1 touring washlight, GLP offers a solution for professional sports and event venues, as well as for all kinds of large-scale events that require dynamically innovative lighting for unforgettable visitor experiences. In addition to the prescribed conventional basic lighting, dynamic and colour-dynamic sceneries can be integrated at any time.

As a touring version of the ArenaLED system with a single luminaire head, it has a power supply unit and DMX connection. This makes it ideal for large-scale events and sporting events where fast, flexible solutions are required.

The ArenaLED1 Touring consists of an extremely efficient luminaire unit with high light generation efficiency and a luminaire luminous flux of up to 24,900 lumens.

creator: German Light Products
description:
Welcome to the official manufacturer GDTF Fixture Profile website from German Light Products. 
We strive to always offer you the latest and optimally coordinated fixture profiles for our amazing fixtures. Since we are known for innovative and unique effect solutions, it is not always easy to implement these physically functioning features as GDTFs – we are in constant contact with controller and visualizer manufacturers in this regard. Our goal is to be able to represent our products as GDTFs as best as possible.
In order to provide you with well-functioning GDTFs early on, we are already offering preliminary GDTFs at a relatively early stage. These are written with priority for control and are marked with "PRELIM."
After the release of these "PRELIM.” versions, we will work on the details for optimal visualization and real physical values. Please understand that full completion will take some time.
Versions without "PRELIM.” are finalized fixture profiles.

creator: TMS_BS
description: The FUSION Stick FS16 Z has a motorized zoom between 10° and 41° beam angle. It is still the same size and dimensions as the FUSION Stick FS20, so all diffusors, including asymmetrical options, and accessories are available to use. The Halo Ring is another innovation implemented to increase pixel visibility in TV applications. In all camera angles the single pixels are visible at any zoom position due to the ring around the front lens and still create stunning narrow beams. The FUSION Stick FS16 Z features an IP rating of 65, allowing for full outdoor use regardless of poor weather conditions. To that end the Stick features a fanless design, which not only ensures the IP65 rating, but also enables silent operation for sound sensitive environments such as theaters or television. The direct vertical hanging and standing are one of the key features to create stunning effects with less rigging effort. No matter the application, the FUSION Stick FS16 Z is the right choice.

description:
The FUSION Exo Spot 30 from FUSION by GLP is a powerful moving head with IP65 classification and a zoom range of 7 to 30 degrees. The Exo Spot 30 uses a highly efficient 230 watt LED engine with a color temperature of 7,500 Kelvin. In addition, there is a whole range of additional features such as     rotating Prism, Frost Filter, Goborad 1 with 8 fixed Gobos, Goborad 2 with 6 rotating Gobos, CMY Color mixing with 18 additional colors, motorized Focus and Zoom, electronic Shutter with variable Speed, 16-bit Pan and Tilt, Weight under 26 kg. So versatile, the Exo Spot 30 can be operated anywhere in the world thanks to a switching power supply with automatic voltage detection.
Wireless DMX is available as an optional control. The rugged housing and its IP65 rating equip the Exo Spot 30 for the most demanding conditions in any environment.

creator: German Light Products
description: he GLP impression X5 Bar is a linear LED batten with 18 powerful 40 W RGBL LED's, a wide zoom range, and the new GLP iQ.Gamut color calibration algorithm that creates perfect white spectrums with excellent color rendering. The new squared lens design ensures maximum lumen efficiency and gives an unprecedented curtain of light at its narrowest angle of just 3.0°, and delivering smooth and homogenous washes all the way out to its widest 63° wash. As a part of the new GLP X5 family it offers a wide feature package, including selectable calibrated white points, a tungsten simulation channel, magenta / green correction, virtual color wheel and variable CTC, along with twin layer effects with plenty of dynamic pattern macros. The impression X5 Bar offers our patented fast tilt movement in combination with seamless pixel pitch across fixtures, and features wired control as standard.

description:
The unique GLP MAD MAXX is the first real LED beam light with a massive 750mm beam diameter. 
This makes it the only beam fixture that is on a similar level with the proven 3kW and 7kW xenon beam lights.

creator: German Light Products
description: The GLP impression X5 IP Bar 1000 is an IP65 rated, linear LED batten with 18 powerful 40 W RGBL LED's, a wide zoom range, and the new GLP iQ.Gamut color calibration algorithm that creates perfect white spectrums with excellent color rendering. The new squared lens design ensures maximum lumen efficiency and gives an unprecedented curtain of light at its narrowest angle of just 4.5°, and delivering smooth and homogenous washes all the way out to its widest 60° wash. Wide feature package, including selectable calibrated white points, a tungsten simulation channel, magenta / green correction, virtual color wheel and variable CTC, along with twin layer effects with plenty of dynamic pattern macros. It offers our patented fast tilt movement in combination with seamless pixel pitch across fixtures, and features wired and wireless control as standard. The impression X5 IP Bar 1000’s enclosure is just as suitable for indoor use on the stage to protect against confetti, fog, pyro and dust.

creator: German Light Products
description: The GLP impression X5 IP Maxx delivers an extraordinary luminous flux of up to 21,000 lumens from 37 powerful 40-watt RGBL LEDs. With CRI 86.7 and a TLCI 88.5, it meets a high standard of color rendering. 19:1 zoom mechanism with 3.56 Mcd light intensity at 3.3° parallel narrow beam and up to 66° homogeneous wash light. New, circular lens design and individual pixel control with pixel mapping and integrated dynamic pattern effects. Extensive feature package such as virtual colour wheel, colour quality control, magenta/green correction, tungsten simulation and a 2-layer effect option. Thanks to the IP65 certification, the fixture can be used both indoors and outdoors in any weather. The compact design, with a weight of < 30 kg, is designed for easy installation in standard pre-rig truss systems. The impression X5 IP Maxx can be controlled via DMX, ArtNet, sACN and LumenRadio CRMX. It also has NFC and the iQ.Mesh module for convenient configuration via the GLP iQ.Service app.

creator: German Light Products
description: The impression X5 IP features 19 x 40-watt RGBL LEDs and up to 11,400 lm TLO. The GLP iQ.Gamut color algorithm ensures precise color mixing, natural skin tones, and flexible CTC from 2,500K to 10,000K. With CRI 86.7 and a TLCI 88.5, it meets a high standard of color rendering. The motorized 17:1 zoom offers 3.6° beam to a wide 63° wash. In addition to homogeneous illumination, the X5 IP offers pixel mapping capabilities and dynamic effects. Thanks to its IP65 certification it is ideal for outdoor events, festivals, and tours. Its sealed housing also protects against dust, dirt, moisture, and pyro or confetti particles in indoor settings. With a lightweight and compact design, the fixture weighs less than 21 kilograms, making installation quick and easy. Multiple control options, including DMX, RDM, ArtNet, sACN, and CRMX. Despite its high performance, the device is energy-efficient, with a power consumption of just 750 watts at 230V.

creator: German Light Products
description: The GLP impression X5 Compact uses 7 powerful 40 Watt RGBL LED’s. GLP’s new iQ.Gamut calibration algorithm ensures the impression X5 Compact creates clean white points with CRI 86 at 6,500 K and the ability to switch to other fixed color temperatures instantly, all calibrated exactly to the black body line. Super-fast zoom mechanics offers a 16:1 range running from 3.6° to 66° with homogenous light distribution across its entire range. A new front face with a circular design offers a fresh modern look, a round aperature and has been designed to include geometric patterns for great looking Pixel mapping effects. Virtual color wheel with 64 referenced LEE Filters, a new Color Quality Control, Magenta / Green Correction, a Tungsten Simulation and Effect Channel and a double layer effect option. Baseless design with a weight of just 7.5 kg / 16.6 lbs. The impression X5 Compact can be controlled via DMX, ArtNet or sACN.

description: The GLP Creos redefines versatility and performance in LED washlights! Equipped with 18 x 40W RGBL LEDs arranged in three rows of 6 pixels each, it delivers breathtaking brilliance and precision. Its motorized zoom creates a powerful 4.3° beam with up to 673 kcd and an impressive TLO of 7600 lm, while the motorized head offers seamless 190° tilt. A standout feature is its clusterable design, ensuring a uniform and homogeneous pixel pitch across multiple devices. Easily link units together to construct massive LED bars and create stunning, dynamic light curtains for truly awe-inspiring displays. The IP65-certified housing guarantees reliable performance in any environment. The GLP Creos is built for convenience and adaptability, featuring PowerCon True 1 In/Out, DMX 5pin In/Out, and two fail-safe EtherNet ports. Compact at under 20 kg, the Creos is designed for effortless handling and everyday use.

description:
PRSTAGE BSW 400CMY Moving Head is a powerful and versatile professional lighting fixture that combines beam, spot, and wash functions. It is equipped with a 400 W LED module and a universal power supply 100–240 V, 50–60 Hz. Smooth and precise movement is ensured by 16-bit motors with 540° (or 630°) pan and 270° tilt, with automatic repositioning.

The advanced color system includes a color wheel with 6 fixed colors, CMY and CTO mixing with half-tone effects, and a bi-directional rainbow function. Two gobo wheels provide creative flexibility: one rotating with 7 interchangeable glass patterns and one fixed with 10 patterns, both with jitter and positioning control.

Motorized focus and zoom offer a beam angle of 2°–17°, gobo 3.6°–38°, and wash 11°–53°. A 4-facet rotating prism adds dynamic effects. The fixture delivers smooth 0–100% dimming and strobe up to 25 Hz with random and pulse modes. It is an excellent choice for professional stage lighting.

creator: PRstage
description:
PRSTAGE  PROFILE PRO 300 RGBALC is a professional theater-profile spotlight powered by a high-output 300 W RGBALC (6-in-1) LED engine. It delivers accurate, vivid color reproduction and is ideal for demanding stage environments.

Featuring manual zoom from 15° to 38°, manual focus, beam shaping (profiling), and iris control, this fixture offers precise optical control. It includes a 16-bit dimmer and strobe capabilities (1–20 bursts per second) for dynamic lighting effects. DMX-512 and auto modes ensure flexible operation; the unit operates across 12 DMX channels. A built-in LED display and sturdy aluminum housing enhance usability and durability.

Power consumption is approximately 350 W from a 100–240 V, 50/60 Hz supply. The fixture is lightweight yet robust, weighing around 12 kg, making it suitable for reliable performance in theaters, studios, and professional venues.

creator: PRstage
description:
PRSTAGE FRAMING SPOT 800 Moving Head is a high-power, precision framing fixture with linear dimmer and strobe up to 25 Hz.

Its color system includes CMY mixing, a 5-color wheel plus open, linear CTO/CTB filters, and smooth color transitions. Two gobo wheels expand creativity: one rotating with 7 indexable gobos and one fixed with 6 patterns, both supporting shake and scrolling effects.
A 4-blade framing shutter with blade rotation, an indexable 4-facet prism, frost filter, and iris provide advanced beam shaping. Pan 540° and tilt 270° with 16-bit resolution ensure smooth motion with Move-Speed adjustment.

Control is via 32 or 33 DMX channels, using 3-pin XLR, PowerCON, and optional RJ-45. The unit runs on a 100–240 V supply (930 W), includes two Omega Fast-Lock clamps, a backlit LCD, and operates from 0 °C to +45 °C. Weight: 24 kg. Size: 690 × 390 × 265 mm.

creator: PRstage
description:
PRSTAGE FRESNEL  400 RGBALC is a professional Fresnel spotlight with a 6-in-1 RGBALC LED engine (Red, Green, Blue, Amber, Lime, Cyan) delivering high color quality with CRI > 95. It features both motorized and manual zoom from 15° to 50°, adjustable via a convenient backlit LCD interface.

The fixture provides smooth 16-bit dimming from 0–100%, strobe effects up to 20 Hz, and multiple DMX control modes (6, 9, or 16 channels). Connectivity includes 3-pin XLR DMX In/Out and PowerCON in/out for reliable integration into any system.

With power consumption of about 450 W from a universal 100–240 V supply, the unit operates stably in temperatures from –10 °C to +40 °C. Compact and lightweight at 10.2 kg, it measures 480 × 350 × 300 mm, making it a practical choice for theaters, studios, and stage applications.

description:
PRSTAGE LED BAR 424RGB+UV is a high-output linear LED fixture featuring 42 multi-chip 4 W LEDs (Red, Green, Blue, UV at 395 nm) with RGBUV mixing, offering over 16 million color variations and long LED lifespan (~50,000 h).

The fixture delivers smooth 0–100% linear dimming, a wide 60° beam angle, and an adjustable electronic strobe ranging from 1 to 20 flashes per second. Cooling is actively managed (the fan can be disabled via the menu), and built-in thermal protection enhances longevity.
Its versatile control includes DMX512, sound activation, auto-run programs, and a Master-Slave mode. Available channel modes are 12, 7, and 4 DMX channels. It offers 3-pin XLR DMX In/Out, an LCD display with four navigation buttons, and includes two adjustable barn doors plus a matte plastic diffuser for beam shaping.

Powered via PowerCON (input + through output) from AC 90–240 V (50/60 Hz), it consumes up to 200 W. The robust metal housing measures 539 × 88 × 140 mm and weighs just 3.2 kg

creator: PRstage
description:
PRSTAGE WASH 1240B RGBL Moving Head is equipped with 12 × 40 W RGBL 4-in-1 LEDs with a lifespan of over 50,000 hours, delivering bright colors, strong wash effects, and dynamic beam looks.

It features a motorized zoom from 3.5° to 45°, allowing both narrow and wide coverage. The unit provides 0–100% smooth dimming, fast strobe up to 25 Hz, and flicker-free operation for broadcast or live use.

Control options include DMX512, auto, sound-active, master/slave, manual, and RDM, with selectable 21/25/33/81 channel modes. A reversible TFT display with English and Chinese menus ensures easy setup. Connections include 3- and 5-pin XLR DMX In/Out and PowerCON power in/out.

With 540° pan and 270° tilt plus position correction, it ensures fast and precise movement. Compact and lightweight at 9.5 kg, the fixture measures 324 × 240 × 383 mm and consumes about 400 W on AC 100–240 V.

creator: PRstage
description:
PRSTAGE WASH 740B RGBL Moving Head is a compact and powerful wash fixture with seven 40 W 4-in-1 RGBL LEDs. It delivers vibrant, long-lasting color effects while consuming only about 250 W.

It features a motorized zoom from 3.5° to 45°, enabling both sharp beams and wide washes. Movement includes 540° pan and 270° tilt with 8- or 16-bit resolution for smooth positioning. The unit offers 0–100% seamless dimming, multiple strobe effects, and flicker-free operation.

Control modes include DMX512, Master–Slave, Auto, Sound-active, and RDM, with selectable 21, 24, 32, or 60 DMX channels. An LCD display ensures easy setup, while connections include 3-pin XLR and PowerCON in/out.

Lightweight and compact, the fixture weighs only 5.5 kg (gross 6.5 kg) with housing dimensions of 258 × 178 × 343 mm. Packed sets of four weigh 27.5 kg. Rated IP20, it is ideal for indoor stage and event applications.

creator: PRstage
description:
PRSTAGE BEAM 295 R14 RING Moving Head is a bright beam fixture powered by a 295 W lamp (approx. 2 000 h lifespan) with 450 W total power draw. It runs on AC 100–240 V, 50/60 Hz and features a bilingual LCD display (English and Chinese) that can invert orientation.

Control options include DMX512 with 24 channels, master/slave mode, auto program, and sound trigger. Movement covers 540° pan and 270° tilt with smooth 16-bit accuracy and electronic error correction.

The lighting system includes 13 indexed gobos plus open, a 13-color wheel plus open, and dual prisms—one 8-facet and another variable (8+16±24 facets) for dynamic effects. It supports mechanical dimming 0–100% and strobe with macro functions.

Optics feature electronic focus and an extremely narrow 0–2° beam, perfect for long, sharp projections. Additional features include overheat protection, flame-retardant housing, IP20 rating, and a compact net weight of only 10.55 kg.

creator: PRstage
description:
PRSTAGE Moving Light F400Z is a powerful 400 W LED wash moving head designed for professional use. It features motorized zoom from 7° to 53°, delivering both narrow beams and wide washes. The fixture offers 16-bit smooth dimming (0–100%) and a strobe effect up to 25 Hz. CTO correction allows color temperature adjustment from 3200 K to 5800 K, making it adaptable to various stage environments.

Pan 540° and tilt 270° with 16-bit precision ensure fast and accurate positioning. The unit supports DMX512 control with 11 or 13 channels, using 3- and 5-pin XLR connections plus PowerCON in/out. Power consumption is about 450 W from a universal 100–240 V supply.

The fixture includes a backlit LCD display, two Omega “Fast Lock” brackets, and operates reliably between –10 °C and +40 °C. Compact and durable, it weighs 24 kg with housing dimensions of 306 × 230 × 526 mm.

creator: PRstage
description:
PRSTAGE LOW FOG 3000 is a professional low fog generator designed for theaters, live shows, and film productions. It creates a dense, ground-hugging cloud that stays close to the floor, delivering a dramatic and mystical atmosphere.

The unit combines high output with fast heat-up time, ensuring quick readiness for performance. Control options include manual, timer, and DMX, allowing flexible operation in different setups. A clear display with intuitive controls makes it easy to adjust settings during use.

Built in a durable housing, the machine is reliable for touring and stage applications. Its compact size and optimized weight provide convenient transport, installation, and operation while maintaining powerful performance throughout the show.

creator: PRstage
description:
PRSTAGE HAZE TOUR 1500 OIL is a high-performance oil-based haze machine designed for professional touring and stage environments. It delivers a consistent, fine haze that accentuates light beams and atmosphere, achieving long hang time and minimal residue.

Featuring a powerful 1500 W heating system, the unit reaches full output in approximately 3 minutes. Its fluid tank holds up to 6 liters, enabling extended operation between refills and making it ideal for long-duration events. Control options include timer, manual, and DMX modes, with a clear LCD menu and dedicated buttons for intuitive management.

Built for durability, this haze machine is housed in a flight-style case with both 3- and 5-pin XLR ports and a PowerCON input for seamless integration into professional setups. It operates on 220–240 V and consumes up to 1600 W. Compact yet robust, its dimensions and weight support easy transport and reliable use under demanding conditions.

creator: PRstage
description: The PRSTAGE SP600 Cold Spark Machine is a professional cold spark effect generator designed for concerts, weddings, theaters, television productions, clubs, and live events. Using non-pyrotechnic titanium alloy granules, it produces spectacular spark fountain effects reaching heights of 1.5 to 5 meters, making it safe for both indoor and outdoor applications. The fixture features adjustable spark height and duration, a fast 3-minute warm-up time, and supports DMX512 and wireless remote control for flexible operation. Its compact, durable construction and reliable performance make it an ideal solution for touring productions, special events, and permanent installations requiring safe and impressive visual effects.

creator: PRstage
description: The PRSTAGE LED SPOT 460 CMY Moving Head is a professional LED spot moving head designed for theaters, concert halls, television studios, and large-scale live productions. Equipped with a powerful 460 W LED engine, it delivers high-output projection with excellent beam quality and reliable performance. The fixture features a motorized zoom range of 6°–42°, CMY color mixing system with CTO correction, color wheel, two gobo wheels, animation wheel, rotating prism, iris, and frost filter, providing a wide range of creative lighting effects. With smooth 16-bit Pan/Tilt movement, precise dimming, electronic strobe, and support for DMX512 and RDM protocols, the fixture integrates seamlessly into professional lighting systems. Its robust construction and advanced optical system make it an ideal solution for demanding stage, touring, and permanent installation applications.

creator: PRstage
description: The PRstage LED BEAM 200 RING is a compact and powerful 200W moving head designed for professional applications. With its advanced optical system, it delivers up to 119,000 lux at 5 meters with a sharp 2° beam angle, making it ideal for concerts, clubs, tours, and stage events. The fixture features motorized focus, a color wheel with 13 vibrant colors plus open, and a fixed gobo wheel with 13 patterns. Its 48-facet rotating prism, frost filter, and rainbow effect expand creative possibilities. The integrated RGB LED ring offers additional visual effects with macros and strobe functions. Smooth 16-bit Pan/Tilt movement (540°/270°) ensures precise positioning, while the intuitive LCD display provides easy control. Operable via 24 DMX channels with RDM support, the unit is equipped with PowerCON and 3-pin XLR connections. With a lightweight 9.5 kg design, the LED BEAM 200 RING combines brightness, versatility, and reliability for modern lighting productions.

Built with a durable metal enclosure, it ensures reliable performance for touring and fixed installations.

description:
A compact and professional 4-channel dimmer pack designed for mobile productions and fixed installations. Ideal for theatres, rental companies, touring setups, clubs, and event venues where reliability and flexible control are essential.
Key Features
4 independent output channels with selectable Dimmer or Switch mode per channel
DMX-512 control with multiple channel modes (4 / 5 / 8 CH)
RDM support for remote configuration and monitoring
16 built-in chase programs with adjustable Fade and Speed parameters
Standalone operation (Manual / Chase modes) without an external controller
Backlit graphic LCD display for intuitive setup and real-time status monitoring
Electrical Specifications
Power supply: 100–240 V AC, 50/60 Hz
Maximum load per channel: 10 A
Maximum total load: 20 A
Maximum total power: up to approx. 4400 W (depending on mains voltage)
Dimming resolution: 8-bit
Designed for resistive and compatible inductive loads

Supporting DMX512 and RDM protocols, the Follow Spot 300W integrates seamlessly into professional lighting systems while its compact design and included stand make it suitable for both touring and permanent installations

creator: RobertJuliat
description: The Sully 650SX Series is a variable zoom profile range featuring a high-quality 115 W warm white LED source (CRI = 98) that delivers a first-class white light and an output that far exceeds 1000 W tungsten luminaires and nearly matches that of 1200 W tungsten models. Combining this new LED engine with the proven optics of the renowned 600SX Series, Sully profile offers accurate framing and superb gobo projection. The LED compartment of the Sully profile can be swapped with those of the 600SX Series (as well as with those of Aledin 630SX or Quincy 420SX Series). It is equally happy on stage, overhead, on side booms or prosceniums, in opera houses, theatres and studios.

description:
- 4 x 300 Watts
- WarmWhite + Amber + Red LED´s
- Up to 40.000lm luminous flux
- 4-lite Audience Blinder, Strobe, Wash

- Being almost twice as bright while consuming 60% less power compared to a conventional DWE blinder
- Emulated “shift to warm” to mimic incandescent fixtures
Individually controllable Pods for stunning pixel effects
- Integrated C-Lok system for toolfree and seemless CLUSTER setups
- Pre-Link Magnets for easy alligning and “one-handed” operation
- Multiple mounting locations for creative rigging options & floor mount
- 16-bit dimming control for smooth, perfect fades
- Four selectable dimmer curves with adjustable response
- Adjustable PWM frequencies up to 25kHz guarantee flicker-free camera operation
- Individual pan of each pod to allow for directional adjustments

description: 5-Master Flame is a high-performance flame effect system featuring five individually controllable flames with heights of up to 6 meters. Designed for professional stage, event, and show applications, it combines striking visual impact with advanced safety technology. The system uses a specially developed high-safety flame fluid, precise air or nitrogen pressure control, and proTEC safety protocols for reliable operation. With DMX, Art-Net, touchscreen control, and optional external tank options, the 5-Master Flame delivers powerful, flexible, and safe pyrotechnic effects for demanding productions.

creator: TBF Pyrotec
description: 5-Master USD (Up Side Down) is the inverted version of the proven 5-Master Flame system. It features five individually controllable flames with heights of up to 6 meters and is designed for overhead mounting as well as flexible installation positions. The system is operated with an external fuel tank and, thanks to its advanced heat protection, can be used safely in various orientations. Control is handled via the proTEC safety control system in combination with DMX and Art-Net, ensuring maximum operational safety. The 5-Master USD delivers powerful, reliable, and safe flame effects for demanding show productions.

creator: TBF Pyrotec
description: 10 Liter Tank is a certified steel fuel tank designed for safe and reliable fuel supply in professional SFX and flame applications. Compact and robust in construction, it is fully integrated into the proTEC safety architecture and compatible with all 5-Master family devices. Control is provided via DMX and Art-Net, with integrated touchscreen operation, and full proTEC safety integration. The 10 Liter Tank ensures stable, uninterrupted fuel delivery and flexible mounting options for demanding stage and event environments.

creator: TBF Pyrotec
description: Magna Fluvia Flame is a high-performance liquid-fuel flame system delivering spectacular flame columns of up to 20 meters. Featuring TBF’s signature flame design and advanced self-priming pump technology, it ensures reliable operation over long distances without the need for an external pump station. Control is provided via DMX and Art-Net and the system operates under the proTEC safety protocol for maximum operational safety. Compact and robust in design, the Magna Fluvia Flame delivers powerful, precise, and safe flame effects for professional stage, event, and show applications.

creator: TBF Pyrotec
description: Liquid Booster is a high-performance auxiliary pump unit designed to extend the maximum suction height of professional flame systems from 10 m up to 50 m. It ensures reliable fuel supply over long distances and significant height differences, while stably supplying multiple devices at the same time. Control is provided via DMX and Art-Net, with integrated touchscreen operation, and full proTEC safety integration. The Liquid Booster provides a robust, user-friendly, and safe solution for demanding stage and show applications.

creator: TBF Pyrotec
description: proTEC Controller is a top-tier safety and emergency-stop control system for intelligent flame and SFX applications in live events and show productions. Designed for FOH and main operator positions, it provides a central overview and secure control of complex setups. Using the proTEC safety protocol developed by TBF Pyrotec and supporting DMX, Art-Net, and sACN, it seamlessly integrates into existing show control environments. With integrated device monitoring, web-based access, and modular expansion options, the proTEC Controller ensures maximum safety, reliability, and professional control for demanding productions.

creator: TBF Pyrotec
description: proTEC Stagebox are high-end safety and emergency-stop control units for intelligent flame and SFX systems used directly on stage. Featuring SIL3-compliant load disconnection, they enable safe shutdown of both proTEC and third-party devices within the emergency chain. Integrated into the proTEC safety protocol developed by TBF Pyrotec and compatible with DMX, Art-Net, and sACN, the Stagebox provides reliable stage-level safety control, modular expansion options, and robust performance for demanding live show environments.

creator: TBF Pyrotec
description: proTEC Flexline Controller is a professional safety and emergency-stop control unit for intelligent flame and SFX systems in live events and show productions. Designed for flexible, stage-side positioning, it can be mounted on truss structures or placed close to the action, providing immediate access to emergency halt and stop functions. Using the proTEC safety protocol developed by TBF Pyrotec and supporting DMX, Art-Net, and sACN, it integrates seamlessly into existing show control networks. With robust construction, touchscreen interface, and modular expandability, the Flexline Controller ensures maximum safety, flexibility, and reliability in demanding production environments.

creator: TBF Pyrotec
description: Switchbox is a professional high-performance switching and control unit for show and stage applications. Fully integrated into the proTEC safety architecture developed by TBF Pyrotec, it delivers fast and precise switching for time-critical SFX and ignition effects. The unit features eight independent output channels, each with freely adjustable switch-on and switch-off times and the option to deactivate individual channels. With touchscreen operation and support for DMX, RDM, Art-Net, and sACN, the Switchbox provides flexible, reliable, and safe power control for demanding live productions.

creator: TBF Pyrotec
description:
Stagebox Dilation is the dedicated expansion unit for the proTEC Stagebox, designed to extend switchable power outputs and load disconnection for professional stage and show applications. It integrates seamlessly into the proTEC safety architecture and enables scalable, SIL3-compliant power management for demanding live productions.
With support for 16A, 32A and up to 63A CEE connections, Stagebox Dilation provides safe shutdown of high-power devices, SFX equipment and third-party systems within the emergency-stop chain. This makes it ideal for complex stage setups, dimmer cities and backstage installations where reliability and safety are critical.
By adding Stagebox Dilation, users can flexibly expand their Stagebox system and adapt power distribution to growing production requirements – without compromising safety, control, or system integrity.

description:
The proTec Power Guard is an intelligent power distribution unit for professional show, event, industrial and pyrotechnics applications. Featuring a 32A three-phase CEE input and six PowerCON TRUE1 outputs, it provides reliable and safe power delivery for demanding setups. Integrated phase monitoring, voltage indication and continuous load monitoring ensure full transparency of the power supply.
Each output is individually protected by state-of-the-art Siemens SENTRON ECPD electronic circuit protection with live current measurement and selective shutdown in case of overload, short circuit or faults. Full integration into the proTec Safety Channel (PTSC) allows flexible safety grouping, emergency stop functions and individual operating modes including ON, OFF, PTSC or DMX + PTSC control. Premium Siemens components guarantee maximum reliability, system availability and future-proof performance in safety-critical environments.

description: For a wide color range and maximum flexibility, the Vari-Lite VL1600 PROFILE combines a high-definition tunable white LED source with CMY color mixing. The tunable white engine lets designers can achieve warm and cool light from a single luminaire without sacrificing output or CRI, along with a wide range of colors from subtle pastels to bold saturated colors. The VL1600 PROFILE includes the innovative Vari*frost system, giving designers a truly seamless graduated frost that diffuses the entire aperture at one time. This effect can be controlled remotely from the console and doesn’t require you to change glass or add filters. To simplify startup and minimize movement in the rig, the patented reduced-movement calibration system in the VL1600 PROFILE calibrates pan and tilt on the fixture while only requiring it to move to 50/50 home position during the process. Fixtures are calibrated in less time, with less lasting effect or potential for damage to the rig or hanging scenery.

description: The Vari-Lite VL3600 PROFILE IP is a large-scale, high output production profile fixture designed to withstand inclement weather without compromising on weight and size. Designed at the forefront of lightweight IP technology, the VL3600 PROFILE IP uses advancements in mechanical design to ensure that even with an IP65 weatherproof rating, the weight and size remain closer to an IP20 (non-weatherproof) fixture. With a 1000W monochromatic light engine producing 85,000 source lumens and an efficient optics system delivering 45,000 lumens out of the front of the fixture, the VL3600’s huge output power is ready to light the show from any distance in any weather. A dedicated color wheel loaded CRI boost and color correction filters ensure colors renders beautifully on stage or on camera. Thanks to a CMY+CTO color wheel mixing system, the fixture produces a wide range of rich colors while eliminating the appearance of blades in the lens, improving direct view applications.

Designed at the forefront of lightweight IP technology, the VL3600 PROFILE IP uses advancements in mechanical design to ensure that even with an IP65 weatherproof rating, the weight and size remain closer to an IP20 (non-weatherproof) fixture. With a 1000W monochromatic light engine producing 85,000 source lumens and an efficient optics system delivering 45,000 lumens out of the front of the fixture, the VL3600’s huge output power is ready to light the show from any distance in any weather. A dedicated color wheel loaded CRI boost and color correction filters ensure colors renders beautifully on stage or on camera. Thanks to a CMY+CTO color wheel mixing system, the fixture produces a wide range of rich colors while eliminating the appearance of blades in the lens, improving direct view applications.

description: Color STRIKE M is an IP65 rated motorized strobe/wash with two ultra-bright, white light tube elements surrounded by an electrifying, color-mixing, and pixel-mappable face. This versatile strobe light can double as a wash fixture with 180° tilt range to throw bright saturated color wherever you need. The IP65 casing protects the fixture from any environmental factors or weather and has two omega-bracket attachments so you can mount the fixture horizontally or vertically without any hassle. Multiple programming personalities give you a varying amount of control from simple set ups with a multitude of built-in effects, or wider control options to take advantage of the pixel-mappable zones: 14 in the RGB face and 28 in the two tube elements. Built-in alignment pins insure perfectly straight linear arrays to create massive arrangements. DMX, Art-net, and sACN control. All LEDs feature 16-bit dimming for smooth fades and Pulse Width Modulation for on-camera use.
